otherConditions: Baccalaureate from a regionally accredited institution required. All prerequisites must be completed with a grade of C or better before the program begins; none may be taken concurrently with ELMSN. Recommended minimum 3.0 GPA on last 60 semester/90 quarter units and 3.0 GPA in the four science prerequisites. AP scores 3-5 and IB scores 5-7 may meet prerequisites if noted on official university transcript.
